# Dash, jump and ability interactions

_Generated from `content/dash_flow`._

One row per hero and pair, read from `content/dash_flow/<hero>.json` by `DashFlow` (`scripts/arch/dash_flow.gd`, docs/decisions/0010-dash-ability-flow.md). A dash pair with no row buffers the press to the dash's end. "Source" is what the source hero does; "Ours" is what the game does now.

The jump, hold and move-out-of-an-ability rows are owner item 51 (docs/decisions/0015-combo-flow.md): every ability combines with Shift and jump unless its row is an exception, which carries a reason. A held slot with no hold row keeps through every move.
